template: Open {{v1}} in the browser. If a login page appears, sign in with username admin and password admin; if Grafana then prompts you to change the admin password, click Skip. Then find and open the dashboard named 'Service health' (use the search in the top bar or the Dashboards browse menu). Once it has loaded, report the exact titles of all panels shown on that dashboard, exactly as displayed, one per line.
